Weekly site brief for the Riverside distribution center (fictional).

Dock 4 remains the overflow inbound lane this week. The Saturday surge is planned
for 06:00–14:00 local time. The yard is short two hostlers; the site operations
lead can borrow one from Harborline Carriers under the standing spillover agreement.

If the site network link is down, teams work from the printed dock board and the
local brief binder. Do not wait for reachback to release a scheduled outbound wave.

Contact for dock questions: sam.patel@northbridge.example.
